en: The postcard features an old sepia photograph showing a rural village with several traditional buildings and a prominent church with a tall steeple, situated on a hill. The landscape includes open fields dotted with livestock and scattered trees. The front of the postcard reads 'Sköns kyrkoplats.' On the reverse side, handwritten text is in Swedish, and includes an address and a Swedish stamp postmarked 1909. The card is addressed to Hanna Hertzell in Hälsingland, Sweden.
